changes: First release. SY MONO, a digital voice machine (slot 40, SY section) on the base's digital voices: a saw, a pulse, a sub one or two octaves down and noise, and a triangle pitch LFO, offered on pads 1 to 8. A read-only ev_amp_record follower at order 80 lets a voice stop once its AMP has closed.
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata; exported instructions and sections are authored module code. Local materialized recipes and firmware are never committed.
